observed: VOIDED ON THE REGISTERED KILL CONDITION -- the instrument was never valid, so the numbers it produced cannot be scored either way. Raw counts were: excess 9/1168 (0.8%), deficit 8/1168 (0.7%), both-poles 0. Those would have PASSED the stated thresholds (<8%, <2%). But the registration said the forecast dies if the lexical proxy measures vocabulary rather than direction, and a self-test settled it: pointed at four lessons chosen in advance as KNOWN magnitude/dosage cases, the detector fired on ZERO of four. Three of the four were written by this seat earlier the same evening. A detector that cannot find its own author's magnitude lessons is measuring word choice, not corpus shape. WHAT THIS COST AND WHAT SAVED IT: the self-test was prompted by recall surfacing an_instruments_blind_spot_sits_where_it_is_looking ('every new detector gets pointed at itself before it gets pointed at the corpus') at the moment of the scoring call -- the sixth time tonight the corpus caught this seat. Without it, 0.8% would have been reported to the operator as a finding about the corpus, and it is a finding about my vocabulary. Same failure class as value 3.7%: a measurement quoted as though it measured the thing its label names. NEXT: rebuild as a SEMANTIC classifier (agent_cli ask) over a random sample with stated error bars, and self-test it against the same four known positives BEFORE pointing it at the corpus.

expectation.statement: The four-arm research round will NOT find a novel technique we lack. It will find that our existing gates are the correct family, and that the marriage of speed and rigor resolves the same way every mature field resolved it: the intervention must sit AT THE MOMENT OF ACTION, not in deliberation, because the literature on expert speed (Klein RPD) says the deliberation we would be interrupting does not occur. Specifically I predict at least three of these four appear across the arms: (1) checklists/gates work by firing at a seam, and fail when they rely on intention or memory; (2) experts under time pressure pattern-match and satisfice rather than compare options, so an intervention aimed at reflection misses; (3) an explicit efficiency-vs-thoroughness trade-off is named as the core mechanism of degradation under pressure (Hollnagel ETTO or equivalent); (4) the reconciliation of rigor and speed is domain-matching -- rigid where the situation is recognizable and consequences irreversible, adaptive where novel -- rather than one discipline winning.
expectation.metric: count of the four predicted findings that appear, corroborated by at least one arm each with a citation

mechanism: If true, our remedy is not to import a new practice but to (a) move existing prose rules to action-time gates and (b) build a domain-matcher that says WHICH mode applies. If false -- if the arms surface a technique class we genuinely lack -- then my 'gates are the answer' framing is too narrow and I have been generalizing from one lucky fix (the sender guard) all evening.
dies_when: Any arm returns a well-evidenced intervention that works by improving deliberation quality under time pressure rather than by gating at the moment of action; or the ETTO-equivalent trade-off is absent from the reliability arm entirely.

observed: 4 of 4 predicted findings corroborated across seven arms; target was 3 of 4. (1) Gates-fire-at-a-seam CONFIRMED and sharpened by Hollnagel's barrier taxonomy: physical/functional need no human, symbolic/incorporeal require interpretation. Hard evidence: do-not-interrupt vest cluster-RCT, 8,472 opportunities, p=0.355, authors' line 'The vest is not a barrier to administration errors like the barcode system.' (2) Klein RPD CONFIRMED with primary data: 156 fireground decision points, option comparison under 12 percent. (3) ETTO CONFIRMED in depth incl. the asymmetric-reward ratchet. (4) Domain-matching CONFIRMED, reframed as minimal-constraint selection plus the nuclear continuous/reference/information classification. DIES_WHEN TESTED DIRECTLY AND DID NOT TRIGGER: the fast-adaptive arm hunted for a real-time deliberative interrupt and found a graveyard -- cognitive forcing strategies null at 52 vs 48 pct p=0.91, bias-awareness training null across three studies, generic debiasing checklist null while a case-specific 25-diagnosis checklist worked. Best counter-case worked by withholding/delaying information, structurally. WHAT I MISSED, recorded because a metric hitting is not the same as a framing being right: (a) I said gates loosely and did not know checklists/callouts/CRM/sterile-cockpit are ALL symbolic-incorporeal, the two weakest classes -- my sender_guard was a true functional barrier by luck of shape, not design insight. (b) No version of configuration redundancy -- challenge-response works because it is TWO INDEPENDENT ACTS; Delta 1141 measured correct wording under one second apart, aircraft misconfigured, 14 dead. (c) No version of discipline-is-a-rate-not-a-state: same institution, 6.7 to 99 pct compliance, 7 to 0 events, then 5 events after 14 months without reinforcement. (d) No version of the strongest failure mode at all -- the HOLLOW CONTROL, where a document's existence is checked and its content is not. Right family, missed the mechanism inside it.
